decisions.rationale: The user wants Kairos to leverage LLM flexibility for reading and generating work documents instead of replacing hardcoded workflows with equally rigid structures.

decisions.decision: DocumentReadResult should be introduced as a minimal runtime intermediate shape, not as a rigid markdown schema.
decisions.rationale: Runtime still needs a stable handoff from LLM reading results, but the document format itself should remain soft-protocol markdown.
